name: bravoforest
description: Nền tảng đổi vỏ chai lấy điểm BravoForest và hệ thống quản lý máy RVM

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,customer,admin,kiosk -c green,blue,cyan,magenta,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start:dev -w @bravoforest/api" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run worker:dev -w @bravoforest/api" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @bravoforest/customer-web" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @bravoforest/admin-web" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @bravoforest/rvm-kiosk"
scripts.dev:management: concurrently -n api,worker,customer,admin -c green,blue,cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start:dev -w @bravoforest/api" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run worker:dev -w @bravoforest/api" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @bravoforest/customer-web" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @bravoforest/admin-web"
